description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPUserSyncAPI class, which provides API endpoints for synchronizing LDAP users within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initiating LDAP synchronization, retrieving synchronization status, and associated helper functions. The class handles API documentation annotations and incorporates LDAP settings validation.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for LDAP user synchronization, including trigger and status retrieval functions, with proper validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPSyncService, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initiates LDAP user synchronization process after validating LDAP settings. Records synchronization status and handles exceptions.

methods.name: saveLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Persists LDAPSyncStatus entity using the LDAPSyncService.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create (sync) endpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the last LDAP synchronization status.

methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving LDAP sync status.

methods.description: Not implemented, intended to list all LDAP sync records.
